brand_identity.emotion: Reverence, profound warmth, ancient wisdom meeting modern elegance
brand_identity.tone: Spiritual, serene, yet bold and award-worthy
brand_identity.core_aesthetic: Organic & Earthy meets Editorial Future. Warm Indian spiritual palette with stark, highly crafted typography.

fonts.usage: Primary headings (H1, H2), editorial blockquotes. Highly stylized, often italicized for impact.
Body text, navigation, buttons, tiny uppercase labels.

rules.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[7vw] leading-[0.9] tracking-tighter font-serif
rules.labels: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-sans font-semibold text-[var(--accent-saffron)]

layout_grids.spacing: Generous. py-24 to py-32 for sections. Gap-8 to gap-12 for grids.
layout_grids.bento_mode_a: Asymmetrical tetris-like grids for 'Our Activities'. Do not make uniform 3-column squares. Mix heights and widths.

scrolling.instructions: Implement Lenis for momentum scrolling to give a premium feel.

hero_reveal.instructions: Masked line-by-line reveal. Split text, wrap each line in overflow-hidden, and translate Y from 100% to 0% with easeOut.

parallax.instructions: Use framer-motion useScroll and useTransform to move hero images at a different speed than the document scroll.

scroll_reveal.instructions: Elements slide up slightly (y: 30, opacity: 0 to 1) whileInView, once: true. Use staggerChildren for lists.

component_architecture.navigation: Sticky top, backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFBF7]/80, sharp bottom border. Links hover to Saffron.
component_architecture.hero: Massive 'SRI BHAVATARINI ASHRAMA' kinetic text. A central arched/clipped image container with parallax. Must feel cinematic.
component_architecture.marquee: react-fast-marquee. 'Divine Mother Tradition • Spiritual Awakening • Seva'. Large serif italics, slow speed.
component_architecture.about_us: Numbered manifesto format (01 / The Tradition). Large quote on left, dense body text on right.
component_architecture.activities: Bento Grid cards. Very subtle background, 1px border. Hover makes image scale 1.05.
component_architecture.events: Minimalist list view. Huge dates (e.g., '15' in Serif), smaller month. Border bottom separators. Saffron highlight on hover.
component_architecture.gallery: Masonry or tight grid. Admin CMS managed. Click opens framer-motion lightbox or simple modal.
component_architecture.donate: Full width dark maroon background. Saffron CTA buttons for Razorpay ₹1001, ₹5001 presets. White text.
component_architecture.contact: Clean form layout. Use Shadcn UI Inputs but with no border radius and flat styling.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Write Javascript (.js/.jsx) only. No Typescript.
CRITICAL: Do not use generic purple/blue gradients or generic center alignment.
CRITICAL: Apply 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, form submits) for testing.
CRITICAL: Do not use `transition: all` in CSS. Target specific properties.
CRITICAL: Use lucide-react for all icons, keeping stroke width 1.5 for elegance.
Implement @studio-freight/react-lenis for smooth scrolling in the main Layout. Give it momentum.
Implement Framer Motion for scroll reveals, kinetic line-by-line text reveals, and parallax.
Override default Shadcn UI styles to remove heavy rounded corners. We want an editorial, slightly sharp aesthetic.
No transparent dropdowns/headers. Always use backdrop-blur or solid background.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Prioritize Awwwards-style typography: huge serifs with incredibly tight tracking for headings.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Create depth through layered design elements and subtle parallax, NOT heavy drop shadows.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, scale up on images).
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (like robot, brain, lightbulb, target) in the UI.
